statements.text: President Trump announced a reciprocal energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine on 11 October 2026.
The UK has committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5,000 LMMs to Ukraine over the next four years.
Prime Minister Andy Burnham has asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid and fiscal packages for Ukraine.
The UK government has announced new funding to help Ukraine through its fifth winter under Russian bombardment.
The UK has announced a new sanctions package, so that over 90% of Russia's oil producing capacity is now covered by UK sanctions.
The UK decided to send air defence and a Voyager aircraft to Saudi Arabia to provide air-to-air refuelling support.
The Voyager aircraft sent to Saudi Arabia has already completed 14 operational missions.
The Prime Minister and Chancellor Merz agreed a new partnership in Berlin to tackle hybrid threats.
In his speech to the UN General Assembly, the Prime Minister confirmed the UK's commitment to establish a new National Centre for Information Defence.
The UK-EU summit will take place in Brussels on 20 November 2026.
In a speech in Scotland, the Prime Minister made an offer of DWP devolution to Scotland.
The Scottish Government has announced a long-term programme for local government reform.
The Scottish Government has agreed this week to match the UK Government's £10 million to create two defence technical excellence colleges.
